correctness.rationale: Nine necklaces proven by primitive period exclusion and Möbius counting. Exact inclusion-or-skip recursion has complete one-to-one correspondence with valid codebooks and an invariant preserving every cross-boundary overlap. It gives all distance-two cardinalities up to size seven; exact inventories and orbit classes are independently checked. A separate integer-encoded exhaustive algorithm produced the same size distribution and 1972 unrestricted maxima.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies a natural sharp conflict between self-synchronization (comma-freeness) and detection of a single corrupted bit, reducing full six-bit payload cardinality from nine to seven. It proves that every unrestricted perfect-necklace packing has Hamming distance one and completely enumerates admissible optimal detectors (272 choices in 68 symmetry classes). This is a finite structural design benchmark, not a generic Hamming bound or an arbitrary parameter slice; longer-length generality is not asserted.
